scientific_integrity: Analytical exact theorem; independent audit not performed; a finite numerical checker provides consistency checks, not continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Two fixed genuinely squeezed Gaussian windows only; fixed positive weights; weighted absolute ambiguity sum on a centered disk.
Does not optimize stochastic noise variance, all signal reconstruction error, or sampled phase retrieval.
Unexamined specialist polarization and optical-design work remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp orthogonal design and angular bifurcation for paired squeezed-Gaussian ambiguity windows
